Manual stress-test tool, not part of mvn test: runs a fixed number of worker threads against a live cluster (or single node) for a configurable duration, firing a weighted-random mix of index/search/delete calls through the same DataNodeClient that Client uses for its demo, and reports throughput/latency/error breakdowns per operation type.

S

search(SearchRequest, StreamObserver<SearchResponse>) - Method in class com.example.inelasticsearch.coordinator.CoordinatorServiceImpl
Two-phase scatter-gather search, load-balanced and fault-tolerant per shard: Phase 1 — round-robin fan-out. For every shard, ask ShardCopySelector.nextCandidates(int) which copy to try (cycling through primary and replicas across successive calls) and remember the full ordered candidate list for fallback.
search(SearchRequest, StreamObserver<SearchResponse>) - Method in class com.example.inelasticsearch.grpc.DataNodeServiceImpl
Parses request.getQuery() as a Lucene classic query against the "body" field and runs it through this node's locally stored shards, restricted per DataNodeServiceImpl.searchShardFilter(com.example.inelasticsearch.rpc.SearchRequest).
search(String, String) - Method in class com.example.inelasticsearch.grpc.DataNodeClient
Unscoped search — the target node applies its own default shard filter.
search(String, String, List<Integer>) - Method in class com.example.inelasticsearch.grpc.DataNodeClient
